name: sac-execution-state-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Prior three-seed SAC models omit active execution state. Test whether exposing that state helps the distinct off-policy learner against legacy and same-dimension masked controls; prior PPO outcomes do not establish the SAC effect.
smoke_parameters: Existing locked SAC smoke configuration;32x32 networks; no hyperparameter selection from smoke returns
selection_metric: Unchanged equal-weight mean validation net return; selected and final weights independently reported

screen_gate.failure: Stop seed11 screen; no confirmation, extra transitions or parameter sweep

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Development gates only; a frozen prospective comparison remains required

constraints.data: Same seven indicators, original immutable training-only preprocessing and26-symbol validation panel across all arms; no new data family
constraints.observations: Legacy12 inputs versus21 masked/full inputs; masked/full same network capacity and state dimension. Additional nine execution fields zero in masked, causal live simulator state in full
constraints.causality: Only current completed market data and actual held execution state. Full-period losing-stock labels reporting only, never inputs/sampling/rewards/checkpoint selection
constraints.simulation: Unchanged four-component actions,100k equity, whole shares, exposure cap1,20-session holding limit, next-session fills, costs and corporate actions
constraints.splits: Train through2020, repeated development2021-2023 only; never open/evaluate2024-September2026
constraints.comparison: All new SAC arms have equal50k budgets. Historical100k SAC results are diagnosis only, not a matched control. Existing PPO results are not the control.
constraints.short_side: Reconcile every new run's long/short costs and marked P&L. Report joint positive total return AND positive net short P&L on declining stocks; never loss reduction alone
constraints.limitations: Survivor stocks, revised Yahoo history, correlated development episodes; no live/paper broker orders

execution.training_location: Google Colab only, actual default Python checked before dependency sync
execution.preflight: Three1024-transition Colab CPU smokes, strict observation/parameter/archive validation and frozen prediction parity before50k screen
execution.runner: Existing central metered owned fleet, original cumulative ledger, bound downloads, verified shutdown and recovery IDs
execution.cleanup: Retain all models/checkpoints/curves; verify publication checksums before removing duplicates; verify every owned session stopped
